description: This file defines the 'CandidateHistory' entity class for a Human Resource Management system, representing historical records of candidate actions, interviews, and related data stored in a database using Doctrine ORM. It includes property mappings, relationships to other entities, and metadata for ORM configuration.

classes.name: CandidateHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing a history record for a candidate, including references to candidate, vacancy, interview, performing employee, and actions taken, along with timestamps and notes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity associated with this history record.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Sets the Candidate entity associated with this history record.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the associated Vacancy entity, if any.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Sets the associated Vacancy entity.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the vacancy as a string.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Sets the name of the vacancy.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Returns the associated Interview entity.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Sets the associated Interview entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action code representing the specific candidate action.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action code.

methods.name: getPerformedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the action was performed.

methods.name: setPerformedDate
methods.description: Sets the DateTime when the action was performed.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns optional notes associated with the history record.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets optional notes.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns a deprecated text field listing interviewers.

methods.name: setInterviewers
methods.description: Sets the list of interviewers (deprecated).
